Chosen as the PRIMARY hypothesis over 'Cairo proper' because: (1) the seed source itself, read at the raw Arabic ('مشروع ازدواج خط العاصمة/ دهشور بطول 67 كم' — 'duplication of the Capital/Dahshur line, 67 km'), and P8058's own Arabic name ('خط غاز العاصمة- دهشور 2') both put العاصمة (Capital) BEFORE دهشور — the same word order GEM's own existing P3930 'New Administrative Capital–Dahshur Gas Pipeline' uses ('العاصمة الجديدة - دهشور'), NOT the reversed order P8040 'Dahshour-Cairo Gas Pipeline' uses ('دهشور-العاصمة'); (2) a straight line from this Dahshur anchor to the NAC anchor is 55.7 km against the sheet's stated 67 km (ratio 1.20x — geometrically plausible for a real corridor), whereas a straight line from the same Dahshur anchor to the P8040-corridor's own Cairo/Giza terminus is only 33.7 km against the same 67 km (ratio 1.99x — implausibly short, would require an unrealistic amount of winding). See flags for why this contradicts the row's English name.

prior_passes.notes: This is a genuinely ambiguous row and I want to be explicit that 'resolved: true' reflects a reasoned primary call, not a confirmed fact. Evidence assembled: (1) EGAS Annual Report 2018 (verified, Wayback fallback used since egyptoil-gas.com timed out live) confirms 'New Capital / Dahshur Pipeline 70 km - 32in', completed July 2017 -- this is GEM's own P3930, corroborating that a real 'Capital-Dahshur' line already exists at ~70 km, very close to P8058's stated 67 km. (2) The 2022 petroleum.gov.eg press release (verified, read via curl+text-extraction of the raw Arabic, not just an AI paraphrase) explicitly calls the 67 km project a 'ازدواج' (duplication/twinning), i.e. a second parallel pipe alongside an EXISTING line -- and P8058's status='construction' (vs P3930's 'operating') is fully consistent with P8058 being that twin, built years after the original. (3) Both P8058's own Arabic name and the press release's Arabic text order العاصمة before دهشور, matching P3930's naming convention rather than P8040's reversed order -- a linguistic clue the English pipeline-name obscures. (4) Straight-line-to-stated-length plausibility clearly favors the NAC corridor (1.20x) over the P8040 corridor (1.99x). Given all four lines of evidence point the same direction and none contradict it, I resolved end=New Administrative Capital, but flagged the naming conflict explicitly so a human can override if there's context I don't have (e.g. a GASCO planning document that explicitly ties this specific construction project to P8040 instead). I could not reach the presidency.eg project page (title: 'إنشاء خط غاز العاصمة الجديدة - دهشور (سيمينز)', which appears to be about the ORIGINAL P3930 line's Siemens/Turboden compressor buildout, not P8058) -- it 403s directly and has no Wayback snapshot; a jina.ai reader proxy returned only nav-menu boilerplate, no article body, so I did not cite it. Confidence tier: medium (2 independent, verified sources -- the 2018 EGAS report for the P3930 baseline and the 2022 ministry release for the duplication project -- corroborate the EXISTENCE and approximate length of a Capital/Dahshur duplication effort, but neither source explicitly disambiguates which 'Capital' terminus by name).
